description: This file defines mock classes for the IDeviceDiagnostics interface and its notification, used for unit testing. It includes method declarations with MOCK_METHOD macros to simulate behavior for testing purposes.

classes.name: DeviceDiagnosticsMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IDeviceDiagnostics interface for testing.

classes.name: DeviceDiagnosticsNotificationMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of the IDeviceDiagnostics::INotification interface for testing.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a notification callback.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of device diagnostics configuration parameters.

methods.name: GetAVDecoderStatus
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of AV Decoder status.

methods.name: OnAVDecoderStatusChanged
methods.description: Mocks callback invoked when the AV decoder status changes.
